verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Apprehend (E) and stack Hemorrhage to 5 for the enrage; you win if you poke with Seismic Shard (Q) and never let him choose the engage.

brief.thesis: Darius has no ranged tool — Decimate (Q) is a self-centered swing with range 1 — while Malphite's Seismic Shard (Q) reaches 625, so the entire lane is about Malphite poking from outside his kill range and only entering melee on his own terms. Ground Slam (E) deals magic damage based on Malphite's own Armor, so every armor item you buy is simultaneously a damage item against him. The 53.9% win rate over 2365 games reflects that structural range/scaling edge, even though OP.GG tags the lane and solo-kill potential as even.

theirWindow.what: At max stacks Darius enrages and gains massive Attack Damage. Don't take another trade here — use Seismic Shard's movement speed steal to walk away and let the stacks fall off instead of testing his enraged autos.

yourWindow.what: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s on cooldown after use. Once he's thrown the hook and missed or not killed you, push the trade with Ground Slam (E) and Brutal Strikes (W) active — he has no way to pull you back into range.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 78.6% pick rate start at 53.5% win rate — the extra sustain from potions is what lets you hold the poke-only pattern against his Decimate healing instead of losing the attrition war in lane.

boots.why: 78.5% pick rate for a reason — Darius's entire kit (autos, Hemorrhage stacking, Crippling Strike) is physical damage, and flat reduction on his auto-attack poke matters more than magic resist he isn't dealing.

core.why: Highest-win-rate core path (58.6% over 152 games) starts here — the health and burn pressure let you stay in auto range during his Decimate windup without losing the trade.
Punishes his Crippling Strike and Hemorrhage-stacking autos directly, and the grievous wounds cuts the sustain he gets back from Decimate's blade heal.
Caps his attack speed once he's enraged at 5 Hemorrhage stacks, blunting the exact moment his kit is supposed to spike.

situational.when: their composition stacks magic damage beyond just Darius
his Decimate blade-hit healing is swinging early trades before you have Sunfire
you're ahead and want to convert the lane lead into full AP burst instead of a tank build

runes.keystoneWhy: Comet rewards exactly the pattern this lane demands — landing Seismic Shard from 625 range to poke him down before he can close the gap, with the follow-up damage punishing every CS attempt he makes near you.

summoners.why: Teleport is the 69.6% pick at 53.4% win rate — it lets you reset off the poke pattern and still arrive for mid-game skirmishes where your Unstoppable Force matters more than a 1v1 kill. Flash+Ignite (56.1% win rate, 27.9% pick) is the alternative if you want to threaten solo kills off Seismic Shard's slow instead.

playing.title: Step out during his Q windup
playing.detail: Decimate has a visible windup and is a self-centered swing with effectively melee range. Back up during the animation and punish with Ground Slam (7s cooldown) once he's committed.

playing.title: Count his Apprehend cooldown
playing.detail: 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s depending on rank. Once it's down after a miss, extend the trade or shove the wave — his only engage tool is gone for a long window.

playing.title: Disengage at 5 Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: His passive enrages for massive bonus Attack Damage at max stacks. Use Seismic Shard's movement speed steal to leave instead of trading into an enraged Darius.

playing.title: Poke every wave with Q
playing.detail: Darius has no ranged tool to answer 625-range Seismic Shard. Chip him on cooldown while farming — he cannot contest it.

playing.title: Pop Brutal Strikes before committing
playing.detail: Activate W for the Armor and Attack Damage buff before an extended trade, both blunting his damage and adding to yours while he stacks Crippling Strike or Hemorrhage.

playing.title: Respect level 6 execute threat
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks. Don't sit at low health while stacked up once he hits 6.

playing.title: Hold R to answer, not to open
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100/80/80s on cooldown — save it to knock him up when he commits Apprehend or Guillotine rather than initiating blind, since whiffing it leaves you with nothing for over a minute.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG — the mechanical reasoning (why each trade, cooldown, and item matters) is my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not bet pulled by Darius during early game! Use [Q] to contest and farm lane!
